summary: In Tirisfal, Executor Zygand sends Forsaken agents from Brill against the Scarlet Crusade. Captain Melrache and his personal vanguard hold a ruined watchtower past Faol's Rest.

sections.title: A Strike at the Vanguard
sections.body: The Forsaken are securing the ruins of Lordaeron while Scarlet Crusade forces keep probing Tirisfal's borders. From a watchtower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest, crusaders lead raids against Forsaken patrols and lands. Executor Zygand chooses to strike at the officers directing those raids instead of waiting for another attack.

sections.title: Captain Melrache's Hold
sections.body: Captain Melrache commands the northern camp, with two sworn bodyguards always at his side. From the tower, the Scarlet Crusade can watch the coastal roads and nearby woods. Killing Melrache breaks the raiders' coordination near Brill, removes a direct threat to Lady Sylvanas's young kingdom, and drives the zealots back toward their stronger fortifications farther east.

faq.answer: Captain Melrache commands a Scarlet Crusade raiding camp at a ruined tower in northern Tirisfal Glades, beyond Faol's Rest. He leads raids into Forsaken lands with his personal bodyguards.

faq.q: Where is the ruined tower located?
faq.answer: The ruined tower stands in northern Tirisfal Glades, just past the graveyard of Faol's Rest, overlooking the northern coast.

faq.q: Why does Executor Zygand want Melrache dead?
faq.answer: Melrache's forces raid from their tower, harassing Forsaken troops and threatening Brill and the Undercity. Zygand orders his death to break the Scarlet Crusade's local offensive.

faq.q: How does this fight connect to the wider war against Arthas?
faq.answer: Executor Zygand sees the Scarlet Crusade as a dangerous distraction. Removing its aggressive officers lets the Forsaken strengthen their hold on Tirisfal and preserve strength for vengeance against the Lich King.

faq.q: Does slaying Melrache clear the Scarlet Crusade from Tirisfal?
faq.answer: No. Melrache's death ends an immediate raiding cell and eases pressure on Brill, but the Scarlet Crusade still holds nearby strongholds, including the Scarlet Monastery to the east.
Faol's Rest is a secluded burial site in northern Tirisfal. Melrache's tower stands in the rugged hills just beyond it.

angles.text: As Forsaken, every crusader you slay is one less fanatic denying your right to live in the homeland where you lived before.
As a member of the Horde, you help protect its vulnerable foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms by securing Tirisfal's perimeter.
As a Rogue, you strike behind enemy lines to separate a commander from the forces around him, as Deathstalkers do.
